pr.title: G04 Reality Check: deadline fairness and verified offline game
pr.body:
Reality Check is the complete offline quiz and bluff game for 2–8 players. Expired timers are consumed before human or bot inputs, preventing late scoring and expired fakes. This follow-up makes the browser and capture evidence independently checkable while preserving the accepted game, UI, bots and data.

Final head `c81b0b7e69b19782613debbc1296c6d56f556927` passes the [complete hosted workflow](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/actions/runs/37846802513), completed at 21:36:03 UTC on 2026-10-08. The full native job 113549581497 log was retrieved and read: 51 tests, 1,003 replay seeds, 21,000 count/mode bot games, 1,000 timer-only rosters, both 10,000-case independent differentials, all 25 real mutation kills, 24,000 default/held-out skill matches, the actual compiled deadline mutant and eight boundary controls, 66 offline gameplay controls, four strict proof tests, all 18 capture refusal controls, and 154 final data/media checksums pass.

The strengthened verifier binds all 1,034 current source inputs, the shared contract, public pinned modules, and actual Node/encoder/decoder identities. It retains 600 consecutive native intervals and 601 timestamp/active phase/private-draft/countdown/clock witnesses per profile, writing raw evidence before assertions. Actual Play, real Pause/Resume and seven bot callbacks remain observable; stale or mismatched three-key nonce grants are rejected. The final hosted run uses fresh independent attempts without transferring the local coordination grant.

- Desktop 1920×1080: 60.003000 FPS; CPU4 phone approximation 390×844: 60.002400 FPS. Both p95/p99 are approximately 16.8 ms, under the unchanged original mean≥59 FPS/p95≤18 ms gate.
- All six original 300-interval profiles also pass, at 60.001200–60.003600 FPS. All 3,000 original and strict intervals remain unfiltered.
- Both current functional clips decode completely: desktop 183,505 bytes and phone 157,680 bytes, each 24 VP8 frames at 12 encoded FPS. All three original 36-frame desktop clips decode completely as well. Capture playback rate is not the measured game FPS.

The genuine final artifact 11580178889 is 1,444,862 bytes, with official SHA256 `56f9427d827bd42cb74b5656842e75dc1fb30402281fd1a15e80607756944a3c`. The public [independent reader](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/blob/c81b0b7e69b19782613debbc1296c6d56f556927/jobs/G04-reality-check/verify-hosted-artifact.py) passed 10,862 assertions at 21:40:34 UTC over its actual 20 safe ZIP entries, exact source identities, all raw intervals and witnesses, 66 controls, and full decoding of all five actual clips. Its SHA256 is `32db337f565c453723b4b0dcad8f190b8460f17cc1006a9ba2f08e5591bc01b7`. Run it from the job folder with the genuine ZIP saved as `actual.zip` and official metadata as `artifact-metadata.json` in the evidence folder:

```sh
python verify-hosted-artifact.py --head c81b0b7e69b19782613debbc1296c6d56f556927 --run-id 37846802513 --evidence-dir <evidence-folder>
```

The actual genuine Playwright encoder and explicitly installed system decoder are distinguished. Hosted Node is 24.21.0; supported decoder is `/usr/bin/ffmpeg`, version 6.1.1-3ubuntu5, SHA256 `ed16af623947494a72e284b6eb8ff225f2da22b38b5d5069c2fd4b4ba3384e41`. The workflow installs it explicitly and preserves exact shared package bytes with `--no-save`. The [public verification record](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/blob/c81b0b7e69b19782613debbc1296c6d56f556927/jobs/G04-reality-check/VERIFY.md) retains the genuine earlier pinned-decoder exit234 failure, failed auxiliary comparison and actual package reproduction, local decoder symlink distinction, interruption gaps and coordination target misses. Actual player KEEP rounds12–14 retain their three-round no-gain stop. This follow-up was normally pushed at observed 21:26:29 UTC and only G04's main claim was refreshed. pr.title: Add Hearts core and offline hot-seat table for 3–6 players
pr.body:
Adds Standard Hearts for 3–6 players with a pure deterministic TypeScript core and a self-contained offline hot-seat page. Settings cover documented deck adjustments, rotating private passes, both moon scores and optional J♦ scoring. Three bot levels use private views; held-out 2,000-game leagues measure strong over medium at 71.10% and medium over easy at 77.95%.

The page provides concealed handoffs, optional clocks, mouse/touch/keyboard controls, locally saved recovery, privately marked received cards and accessible outcomes. Manage holds the clock and selected pass. Player/core/browser/art/data/native frame sampler remain byte-identical to the original 3c28358 delivery.

The verifier binds 30 immutable inputs, fully decodes the actual current 36-frame 1920×1080 VP9 recording, retains every decoded framehash, and records that clip's host Node and decoder executable/version/SHA/arguments. It checks source/tool bytes again after decoding. Four genuine, coherently hashed negative files cover non-video, truncation, a fully decodable one-frame substitute and a fully decodable phone-shaped substitute. The delivered Python reader independently checks official ZIP bytes, immutable source, every native interval and every actual decoded frame.

Final exact head **85d373c5c7eaa946acc84ed316098d63fa4eac8b** passed both complete [push checks](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/actions/runs/37851902643) and [PR checks](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/actions/runs/37851908687). Full native logs were read independently: 37 tests, 25 real mutation kills, 1,003 replay seeds, 1,000 complete bot games at every 3–6-player count, 10,000 independent comparisons, two 2,000-game strength leagues, 38 validated JSON files, 29 research receipts and two byte-identical 96-file regenerations all passed.

Both genuine final artifacts were downloaded with official complete bytes/digests and independently accepted: **137 public-reader and 286 separate private-reader assertions per artifact**, all 30 current Git/package inputs, 1,200 native intervals, 20 functionals, four media controls and all 36 actual decoded frames each. Push artifact **11582072044**, 937,146 bytes, SHA256 bee51b88de3d3e2137253f6c1b563f5107d3d976003c126ed8e8e00b9fa84b28; PR artifact **11582646194**, 937,279 bytes, SHA256 c520b822aa9f32fd9776aa6a6085595dde9a8532d1239a0d6f094d8db41f6046. Current host Node24.21 and FFmpeg6.1.1 identities/commands are bound; all 36 decoded pixel/PTS/DTS/duration/byte rows agree with actual independent FFmpeg7.1.5 decoding. Different host binaries and output headers are separately scoped.

Both full runs retain 600 consecutive unfiltered intervals per desktop and CPU4× phone after the original explicit 60-frame warmup. All four measured profiles are about60.002–60.003 FPS with p95/p99 about16.7–16.8ms under unchanged ≥59 mean FPS / p95≤18ms gates. This describes the steady-state private-pass selection workload, not startup or a physical phone; the original runner has no per-frame native-API/phase witnesses. Fresh milestone18's 20 functionals/3–6 rosters/30 equal input maps/full decoded clip are separately scoped nongating evidence.

Previous65a310b and original3c actual artifacts/logs/executed readers are preserved publicly. Old local58.634/57.695/55.047 FPS failures and auxiliary/publication-order failures remain visible; causes are not invented and unchanged local FPS workloads were not retried for luck. Original KEEP11–13 genuinely completed three consecutive reviews with no noticeable player gain; unchanged gameplay preserves that stop. MIT original code/art and Zod notice are retained; shared contracts are unchanged. Delivery is ready for review and remains unmerged.

pr.title: G06: partnership and Cutthroat Spades core with offline hot-seat play
pr.body:
Complete offline Spades with four-player partnerships and three-player cutthroat, nil/blind nil, bags and 500-point matches, private handovers, optional exchange and three bot strengths. The zero-deficit blind-nil setting now correctly describes tied or trailing teams; eligibility and strategy are unchanged.

Final head 48430c9861534edfef8c59528de4279ebd6cec78 passed the complete G06 workflow 37807419404 at 16:28:19 UTC: strict types and byte-identical data/page checks, two 10,000-case differentials, 31 core tests, 25 real mutation kills, 1,003 presence cases, 16,000 skill games, 13 browser groups and three exact UI/core matches. Twenty-one focused groups also passed, including 58 current-source evidence corruption controls, nine nonce protocol groups and twelve real capture CLI rejection controls. Capture requires one explicit valid unused milestone and refuses existing video/report files before browser launch.

I downloaded the actual final five-file artifact 11565005070 and verified its 104,184-byte ZIP against GitHub's SHA-256 13aaf20b75d803750dbfbb999304ab1480bb2c3fb9cbdc8b5908f0bc6d2cd294. Independent validation recomputed all 1,800 unfiltered intervals and checked eighteen current source guards: TV and CPU4 phone both 60.0028 FPS, p95 16.7/16.8 ms. The actual source-bound milestone13 clip is 95,085 bytes, SHA-256 1df6c6c07b08a336fa171b5b83772e8de30c424b4b308e1957d27ffb5c73bd7b, with ten matching guards and zero application/network errors.

Review rounds 10–12 produced three consecutive rounds without a player-facing gain after the visible setting-label correction; the final independent audit found no substantive gap. The local TV failure at 58.381 FPS, phone-not-run status and unresolved cause remain recorded separately from hosted success. CPU4 approximates a phone; encoded 12 FPS clips document functionality and do not measure frame-rate acceptance.

pr.title: G09: deliver Category Rush core and offline play
pr.body:
Category Rush delivers a complete offline game for 2–8 players: 320 original prompts, 4,155 authored examples, seeded rounds, private answer sheets and anonymous ballots, duplicate cancellation, three bot skills, saved-game recovery and scored receipts. Its pure TypeScript core follows the shared contract.

Pasted article/tab/vertical-tab/DEL answers retain visible word boundaries before private advice, saving and submission. Fourteen native clipboard cases at two/eight humans rescue six formerly zero-point authored answers; eight ordinary/newline controls retain their score. Caret, backward selection, 80-character bounds, private handovers and negative scoring controls pass.

Final acceptance is fully green on exact `7f5a0bda747fdb79b350f7780cff6b655bc2b3ad`: [run 37847981850](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/actions/runs/37847981850), job 113553541133, completed at 21:57:17 UTC. The complete 147,400-character log confirms 69 tests/pass 69/fail 0, both 10,000-case independent oracles, 7,000 restored games/all nine invariants, 1,003 property seeds, 43 actual mutation kills, 4,000 bot duels, deterministic regeneration and every original/new browser stage. The fresh late-save artifact checker also passes after replay.

The genuine official artifacts were downloaded and independently checked against their exact source/run, ZIP digest, safe entries and actual payloads:

- Strict artifact **11581130237**: 1,349,771 bytes; SHA-256 `20cd883cb07a673eaa2bf8eb267087e9d783772703b77245fa708aceedb362d4`. All eight files, 18 source guards, 1,200 native frame intervals and 1,202 active-answer/native-clock/timer witnesses pass. Desktop/phone-4x measure 60.002976/60.003180 FPS with p99/max 16.8 ms; timers advance 60→50. Both genuine 353,472/265,754-byte VP8 recordings fully decode.
- Recovery/late artifact **11580709186**: 3,031,477 bytes; SHA-256 `ba11e7b3b420ed1116501e9be8acf0520c9bb4e1eb54fc800cb86870db56eafa`. Its 50 safe files pass 10,377 independent assertions covering 17 fresh recovery controls, twelve authentic legacy-save pairs and the native late-game workload. All 29 archived save payloads decode as valid using the current decoder.

Legacy saves transfer byte-for-byte from the older page into the current page. Private handover hides old drafts, preserves 53 seconds through a 120-second functional wait, then writing advances the timer to 48 seconds. Eight valid cases score one; four repeat/wrong-initial cases score zero.

The fresh late-game replay actually plays four complete eight-human rounds and 384 private scored groups, then retains a 94,429-byte fifth-round handover with 84 submitted long answers. Both profiles record 960 trusted character inputs. All twelve 80-character drafts save and recover privately with history, scores, RNG and elapsed writing time intact. Two navigation initializer attempts produce one seed write. The actual 271,283-byte phone recording fully decodes 118 VP8 frames over 4.72 seconds. Nineteen current source guards and every trusted character prefix match. These native input observations add no FPS sample or hard handler-latency gate.

The first local late-game observer remains archived: typing/saving passed, but its every-navigation test initializer overwrote the new draft on reload; phone and capture were not run. Only that isolated seed-once setup was corrected. The corrected local phone observer's actual 55 ms long task retains an unresolved cause; differences between local/hosted attempts are not an optimization claim. Earlier local phone FPS failure, expired-handover scope, rejected extra-key pre-sampling grant and unsupported extra Date-versus-RAF diagnostic failure also remain intact. Original gates are unchanged. Phone 4x approximates a device; English morphology and storage-latency coverage remain bounded.

KEEP GOING is complete: seven measured player gains followed by three actual reviews without a new player-visible gain. LOOP.md, audits and NEXT.md retain the stop condition, resume instructions and failures. The final evidence reviews leave production HTML/core/data/bots/RNG/save format unchanged. The completion was normally pushed at 21:36:30 UTC and only the G09 main claim was refreshed.

pr.title: Complete American and International Checkers with full six-piece bots
pr.body:
American bots previously waited for the entire 1.39 GB page, including International data. This draft change enables American bots once their own complete data is present; International bots still wait for every required part. Game logic, bot strategy, seeded randomness, original databases, licenses and browser workloads remain unchanged.

Current head: `df123c797b226c479b50a998011c1ea6d0157391`. The implementation copies the measured candidate browser source and adds one exact 81-byte readiness marker after the complete American payload. Production code has no dependency on private workspace files.
